headline_marked: Claude Code [[beats Copilot in code archaeology]] for 50k-line codebases
headline: Claude Code beats Copilot in code archaeology for 50k-line codebases
summary: Developer compares Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for 30 days. Claude Code excelled in code archaeology and complex tasks.
details: The developer used Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for 30 days to compare their performance. Claude Code excelled in code archaeology, understanding large codebases, and complex tasks.
Claude Code can read through large codebases, find relevant modules, and explain the code flow. It also offers to show specific functions and can perform multi-file edits.
GitHub Copilot is faster for line-by-line suggestions while typing and is better suited for writing boilerplate code or implementing familiar patterns.
The developer now uses Copilot for IDE completions and Claude Code for more complex tasks, finding the $10/month Copilot and $20/month Claude Pro worth the cost.
caption:
Which AI coding assistant reigns supreme? A developer shares their 30-day test results.

The developer used Claude Code and GitHub Copilot for 30 days to compare their performance. Claude Code excelled in code archaeology, understanding large codebases, and complex tasks.

Claude Code can read through large codebases, find relevant modules, and explain the code flow. It also offers to show specific functions and can perform multi-file edits.

GitHub Copilot is faster for line-by-line suggestions while typing and is better suited for writing boilerplate code or implementing familiar patterns.

The developer now uses Copilot for IDE completions and Claude Code for more complex tasks, finding the $10/month Copilot and $20/month Claude Pro worth the cost.

headline_marked: Claude Science [[reproducible AI analysis]] for life sciences
headline: Claude Science reproducible AI analysis for life sciences
summary: Streamline scientific computing with reproducible AI analysis
details: The Claude Science app runs analyses, searches databases, and traces every step from data wrangling to publication. It allows users to view proteins, structures, and molecules natively, with every result reproducible and traced to its code.

The app includes features such as background reviewers that flag incorrect citations, annotatable figures, and the ability to write up results alongside the analysis that produced them. It also manages environments and compute on laptops, clusters, or GPUs.
Claude Science connects to databases and tools, and is pre-configured for major domains in life sciences. It's available now for macOS and Linux.
caption:
Can AI make scientific analysis fully reproducible?

The Claude Science app runs analyses, searches databases, and traces every step from data wrangling to publication. It allows users to view proteins, structures, and molecules natively, with every result reproducible and traced to its code.
